meta.name: prioritize
meta.description: Choose up to three immediate priorities from competing initiatives. Use when everything is urgent and the customer needs a defensible order with explicit deferrals.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一堆都喊紧急的事项排出先后,明确先做哪几件、哪些暂缓
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上事情都标着紧急,却需要给出一份站得住脚的先后顺序
copy.tagline_en: Rank competing initiatives into a defensible order and name what gets deferred
copy.fit_line_en: For you if everything feels urgent and you need a defensible order for what comes first

howto.what: 当你手头多个事项互相竞争、都很急时,它从中挑出最多三个当下优先项,给出有依据的先后顺序,并明确写出哪些被推迟。
howto.when: 当所有事都显得紧急、你需要一份站得住脚的顺序和明确的推迟项时触发;若由 @fde 调用,则沿用其当前上下文与范围,不重开流程。

say.text: 这几件事都很急,帮我挑出最多三个现在要做的
say.note: 会给出排序并列出被推迟的项

say.text: 把先做的和推迟的分开写清楚,说明理由
say.note: 产出带明确推迟项的优先清单

say.text: 别重启流程,用 @fde 已给的上下文重新排序
say.note: 复用现有上下文,不重复提问

howto.what_en: Picks up to three immediate priorities from competing initiatives, gives a defensible order, and states what is deferred.
howto.when_en: Use when everything is urgent and you need a defensible order with explicit deferrals; when called by @fde it reuses that packet and scope instead of restarting setup.

say_en.text: Everything here is urgent, pick up to three things to do now
say_en.note: Gives an order and lists deferrals

say_en.text: Separate what goes first from what is deferred, with reasons
say_en.note: Produces a priority list with explicit deferrals

say_en.text: Do not restart; re-rank using the @fde context already given
say_en.note: Reuses existing context, no repeat questions
